title: SerreSectionModuleTailFinite
statement: Let k be a field, S=k[x_0,x_1], P=Proj S as in [def-sc-p1-standard], and G a coherent O_P-module [pqf-def-coherent]. Let M be an S-module with additive subgroups M_z, with S_e M_z contained in M_(e+z), and additive isomorphisms phi_z:M_z -> Gamma(P,G tensor O_P(z)) for z>=0 respecting homogeneous multiplication via twistMul of [def-weil-pbc-proj-twisting-sheaf]. There exists N>=0 such that the S-submodule spanned by all M_z with z>=N is finitely generated. No internal direct-sum condition or finiteness of the remaining degrees is required.

source.place: Stacks Project, Lemma 01YS (https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01YS), proof of (5); online text read because the local checkout is absent

proof.text: Apply eventual coordinate surjectivity to G and obtain a natural N. For z>=N use the two preimages of phi(z+1)(y), pull them back by phi(z) inverse, and use hsmul to give coordinate multiples their subtype membership. The two hphi equations and injectivity of phi(z+1) give y=x0*y0+x1*y1 in M.

Let L be the S-span of M_N. Component finiteness makes L finitely generated. Induct on n>=N: the base is subset_span, and the preceding coordinate decomposition plus scalar and additive closure of L proves M_n subset L. Convert z>=N to z.toNat using nonnegativity. The span of all tail degrees is contained in L; conversely M_N lies in that tail, so its span contains L. Thus the tail span equals the finitely generated L.

proof_origin.place: Alternative reduction of Tag 01YS (5) using eventual coordinate multiplication from (4); Lean proof written by U3
